correctness.rationale: An independent symbolic check uses the physical backward generator, its centered Poisson problems at zero bias, and left boundary current (rho_L-E[n_1])/2, rather than the uploaded forward bond-flux perturbation code. Stationarity conserves flux and makes these currents equal. It verifies both rational coefficient identities, positive polynomial coefficients, and exactly one derivative root on (0,1) by Sturm counting, with negative/positive endpoint signs. The verified optimum is u=0.318913576516811551474..., magnitude 0.00323613399987347948353..., and -log(u)=1.14283513291274316975.... At u=1 the first-moment equations are the linear current equations of five unit-resistance links (three interior and two reservoir), giving d/10. Reflection makes the three-site centered-defect current odd, and there is no interior site on shorter chains. Positive transition rates under the stated hypotheses imply analyticity at d=0 via the normalized finite stationary system. Replay: python3 /workspace/reviews/evidence/trap_response.py; output reviews/evidence/trap_response.txt. The proof verifies near-equilibrium optimization only, not optimal finite bias.
